verdict: Leads are arriving; cost per lead is rising and intake pipeline is stalled.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 168 leads from Meta at an average cost of $12.77 per lead — but cost per lead rose 22% this past week on nearly flat spending, meaning ad efficiency is slipping. At the same time, 0 of those leads have moved into your intake pipeline as opportunities, which is the more pressing issue: leads are coming in and stopping there. Three intake tools — SMS automation, voice access, and the signed extension — are overdue and their absence is the direct reason the pipeline shows no activity. We are pushing to close those gaps this week so leads can be properly worked before the retargeting automation goes live at month-end.
